text:
anya: Heads-up: we keep seeing behavioral drift when controlplane translates hosted -> private variants (tokenization + headers). Need quick guardrails.
jamal: saw that too. Example: hosted rw-small vs private rw-small-int8 changed JSON field ordering for table outputs.
samir: that's the tokenization/serialization mismatch. Long term we want equivalence proofs, short term need runtime checks.
anya: proposal: 1) require adapter manifest flags: `tokenizer_preserved` and `response_shape_preserved`, 2) block full-traffic routing if either is false/unknown, 3) enable a 0.1% canary + 10-sample probe corpus for translations.
jamal: tradeoffs: adds a canary step for every mode-translation; could slow onboarding. But safest.
infra-bot: feature-flag note: `adapter-translation-canary` exists in staging.
samir: also add audit events: translation_requested, translation_applied, probe_result, fallback_invoked. Ops needs these for root cause.
anya: UX: Console should tag routes "mode-translated" and surface probe status + last probe hash.
jamal: ok. I'll add a short rollout playbook for immediate enablement and edgecase where fallback must queue instead of variant fallback.
samir: i'll update the manifest schema and include a small proof artifact for tokenization hashes.
anya: timeline: schema PR this week, canary gating in controlplane next sprint. Meet after PR lands.
